chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era 336 — A Daofather's Disciple: The True Prize of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly
chapter_meta_description: The Grand Xia Emperor reveals the staggering rewards of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, including a chance to become Daofather Crimsonbright's disciple. Ji Ning faces the true scale of the cosmic power hierarchy.
og_title: The Emperor's Declaration — Desolate Era Ch. 336
og_description: The stakes of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly are laid bare as the Grand Xia Emperor offers Immortal treasures, Primordial Liquid, and a place as a Daofather's disciple.
twitter_title: A Daofather is watching! Desolate Era 336
twitter_description: The Grand Xia Emperor drops the hammer: the winner of this tournament gets to become a disciple of a cosmic god-king!

lore_anchors.definition: In the Desolate Era Xianxia world, a True Immortal who has transcended the Five Elements and achieved immortality. They are the rulers of sects and commanderies, capable of shattering dimensions and wielding the power of the Heavenly Dao.
A transcendent being who has mastered a Grand Dao, ranking above Celestial Immortals. They are figures of legend, rarely seen, and their word is law even to emperors.

The creator of the Crimsonbright Diagram of the Nine Heavens and the master of the Grand Xia Emperor. He is a Daofather, a being who wields a Heavenly Dao and commands dozens of major worlds in the Three Realms.

A weapon or artifact imbued with the power of an Immortal, vastly superior to mortal or Earth-ranked treasures. Only a handful exist in most commanderies, making the Emperor's offer of forty-eight a staggering show of wealth.
The ultimate essence of natural energy, so pure it can be absorbed instantly without burdening the body. It is a legendary cultivation resource, used as high-value currency among Immortals.

A slovenly, fat youth from the Black-White College. He is secretly a true disciple of Lord Xuanwu, a major power of the Three Realms, making him the pre-selected favorite of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
A Chaos True God and master of the Northern Seas, alluded to as a peer of Daofather Crimsonbright. He represents the pinnacle of Fiendgod Body Refining in the Three Realms.
